In mathematics, the '''May spectral sequence''' is a [[spectral sequence]], introduced by {{harvs|txt=yes|first=J. Peter|last=May|authorlink=J. Peter May|year1=1965|year2=1966}}. It is used for calculating the initial term of the [[Adams spectral sequence]], which is in turn used for calculating the [[stable homotopy groups of spheres]]. The May spectral sequence is described in detail in {{harv|Ravenel|2003|pp=67–74}}.
